description: Run one bundled guard assessment inside an open Position Lifecycle (purchased with position_lifecycle_begin). Choose the guard family per call; params use that family's native input (the same schema as the family's standalone guard tool), and solana_lending additionally requires the exact unsigned Solana lending transaction. Covered by the lifecycle purchase — no per-call charge — but consumes one of the 4 bundled guard slots; a BLOCK verdict is a complete assessment and consumes the slot. Authenticates with the one-time lifecycle token.

params.description: The native guard input for the chosen family (same schema as the family tool)

transaction.description: Required for solana_lending: the exact unsigned Solana lending transaction the guard evaluates

name: position_lifecycle_guard
